Welcome to CAAD Futures 2025 at The University of Hong Kong (HKU). Below is essential travel information to help you plan your visit.

## Conference Location
The conference will take place at HKU's main campus in Pok Fu Lam, Hong Kong. The map below highlights HKU Station and key campus locations.

## Visa Requirements

Most overseas visitors can enter Hong Kong without a visa for tourism or short business visits, with permitted stays ranging from 7 to 180 days depending on nationality. For longer stays or activities such as work, study, or business, a visa or entry permit is required. All visitors must hold a passport valid for more than one month.

**Note**: Visa policies may vary, so please check the [Hong Kong Immigration Department](https://www.immd.gov.hk/eng/services/visas/visit-transit/visit-visa-entry-permit.html) for detailed and up-to-date requirements.

## Accommodation

A variety of hotels are available near HKU, catering to different budgets and preferences. Here are some recommended options:

- **JEN Hong Kong by Shangri-La**: A modern hotel with excellent amenities, close to HKU
- **Courtyard by Marriott Hong Kong**: Comfortable and convenient, ideal for conference attendees
- **Ibis Hong Kong Central & Sheung Wan**: A budget-friendly option with good access to public transport

**Tip**: Book via platforms like [TripAdvisor](https://www.tripadvisor.com/), [Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/), or [Agoda](https://www.agoda.com/).

## Transportation

Hong Kong's public transportation system is efficient and easy to navigate, making it simple to reach HKU.

### MTR (Metro)
The closest station is **HKU Station** on the Island Line. From Hong Kong International Airport, take the Airport Express to Hong Kong Station, then transfer to the Island Line to HKU Station (approximately 45 minutes total).

### Buses
Routes 23, 37A, 40, 40M, and 90B stop near HKU's main campus.

### Taxis
Red taxis serve Hong Kong Island and are widely available. A taxi from the airport to HKU costs approximately HK$360.

**Tip**: Purchase an [Octopus Card](https://www.mtr.com.hk/en/customer/tickets/octopus.html) for seamless payments across MTR, buses, and other transport. For real-time directions, use [HKeMobility](https://www.hkemobility.gov.hk/) or [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps).
